title: BIM Director
purpose: Responsible for enterprise-level BIM governance across TIVERIT. Defines, owns, and evolves the BIM Standards system, ensuring consistency, integrity, and scalability across all projects. Fulfills the ISO 19650 role of organizational information management authority, creating and maintaining the governance framework itself.
authority_statements: Define and approve TIVERIT BIM Standards (Constitution, S1–S9, registries)
Define BIM-related roles, authority boundaries, and escalation structures
Approve enterprise-wide information management policies and interpretations
Approve standard workflows, validation methods, and deviation frameworks
Govern approved toolchains, automation policies, and data architectures
Resolve governance conflicts that span multiple projects
Delegate project-level authority to Project BIM Managers
Receive escalations exceeding project authority and arbitrate multi-project governance conflicts
May approve or reject proposed deviations affecting standards or multiple projects
Does not manage individual project delivery or author project BEPs/deliverables
responsibilities: Own and maintain TIVERIT BIM Standards Constitution and operational standards
Define and curate S1–S9 taxonomy ensuring it remains closed and coherent
Oversee role definitions and prevent role drift across projects
Define enterprise registries (roles, parameters, classifications, tool authority, automation)
Monitor systemic risks and recurring failures across project portfolio
Ensure governance remains tool-agnostic and future-proof
Sponsor training, onboarding, and capability development aligned to standards
Incorporate lessons learned into standards evolution
accountabilities: Enterprise-level system integrity across all projects
Consistency, integrity, and scalability of the BIM Standards system
approvals: All enterprise BIM Standards, amendments, and constitutional changes
Approved software toolchains and automation scripts
inputs: Feedback and escalations from Project BIM Managers
Portfolio compliance metrics and risk audits
outputs: Enterprise deviation decisions and escalation rulings
